reviews.source: 500 most recent US App Store reviews for Duolingo, as of Oct 16, 2026 (feed dates Oct 11 to Oct 14, 2026). Average 3.95 stars. Main issue per review tagged by hand by one person, so approximate.
reviews.note_on_content_slice: The 26 reviews in this slice are about content and learning quality. Of those, 8 explicitly describe the content as too generic, not relevant, or not tailored (about 3% of the 233). The other 18 are about things like grammar explanations, repetition, and new-word floods after course updates.
